# Pizza Tascio

> Pizza Tascio is a New York style pizzeria with nine locations across the Kansas City
> metro (Missouri and Kansas), serving hand-tossed pizza by the slice and whole 18-inch
> pies. Dough is cold-proofed 3–4 days and baked on stone deck ovens. Voted KC's Favorite
> Pizza (The Kansas City Star) and Best Pizza in the Midwest (Midwest Living).

Key facts: The Combo is two big NY slices and a drink for $10, in store, every day.
Cheese slices $4.50, specialty slices $5 (in-store only). Whole pies $24–$29, in store
or online for pickup and delivery (https://www.pizzatascio.com/s/order). Signature ingredients: Dinapoli (Bianco DiNapoli) sauce, whole-milk / fresh mozzarella, fresh ricotta, Ezzo crispy cup pepperoni, Paradise Locker Italian sausage, Mike's Hot Honey, roasted garlic EVOO, sharp Parmesan, fresh basil.

# Full content

## Pizza Tascio — New York Style Pizza in Kansas City

Pizza Tascio is a New York style pizzeria serving hand-tossed pizza
by the slice and whole 18-inch pies at nine locations across the
Kansas City metro (Missouri and Kansas). Dough is mixed in-house and cold-proofed
for three to four days, pies are stretched by hand and baked on stone deck ovens, and
slices are cut from display pies and reheated to order.
The Combo — $10: two big New York slices and a drink,
all day every day, in store. Cheese slice $4.50; rotating specialty slices $5. Slices are
in-store only; whole pies are available in store or online for pickup and delivery at
https://www.pizzatascio.com/s/order.

### Awards
- Voted KC's Favorite Pizza — The Kansas City Star
- Voted KC's Favorite Deal — The Kansas City Star
- Best Pizza in the Midwest — Midwest Living
- Top 40 Restaurants in KC — KC Magazine
- Top 25 New Pizzerias in the Nation to Watch — Pizza Today
- Rated 8.1 — Barstool Sports

### Signature ingredients

Dinapoli (Bianco DiNapoli) sauce, whole-milk / fresh mozzarella, fresh ricotta, Ezzo crispy cup pepperoni, Paradise Locker Italian sausage, Mike's Hot Honey, roasted garlic EVOO, sharp Parmesan, fresh basil.

### On this site

- All nine locations — addresses, phones, hours

- Menu — pies, slices, prices

- Catering — Pizza Trailer and White Glove Delivery

- Pizza classes

- Frequently asked questions

Contact: customerservice@pizzatascio.com ·
Instagram: @pizzatascio ·
Main website: https://www.pizzatascio.com

## Pizza Tascio Menu

### By the slice (in store only)

- The Combo — $10: two big New York slices & a drink (all day, every day)

- Cheese slice — $4.50

- All other slices — $5 (rotating specialty options)

Slices are cut from display pies and reheated to order on the stone deck. They are not
available for delivery — a slice is at its best moments out of the oven.

### Whole pies — 18", feed 4–7 adults

 | Pie | Price | Description
 | Cheese Pie | $24 | Dinapoli sauce with fresh mozzarella.
 | Pepperoni | $26 | Dinapoli sauce, mozzarella & Ezzo crispy cup pepperoni.
 | Margherita | $28 | Dinapoli sauce, mozzarella, ricotta, sharp Parm, roasted garlic EVOO & fresh basil.
 | Spicy Pep | $28 | Dinapoli, mozzarella, Ezzo pepperoni, jalapeno & Mike's Hot Honey.
 | Sausage | $26 | Dinapoli sauce, mozzarella & Paradise Locker Italian sausage.
 | S.P.O. Pie | $27 | Dinapoli, mozzarella, Paradise Locker sausage, onions & peppers.
 | Red Tascio | $29 | Dinapoli, mozzarella, ricotta, Ezzo pepperoni, basil & Mike's Hot Honey.
 | White Tascio | $29 | White pie, mozzarella, ricotta, Paradise Locker sausage, broccoli & garlic EVOO.
 | White | $27 | White pie with mozzarella, fresh ricotta & roasted garlic EVOO.
 | Veggie | $28 | Dinapoli, mozzarella, mushrooms, peppers, onions & tomatoes.

Menu categories: Slices, Pies, Salads, Extras, Dessert. Full menu with current specials:
https://www.pizzatascio.com/menu. Order online for pickup or delivery:
https://www.pizzatascio.com/s/order.

## Pizza Tascio Catering (Tascio To-Go)

Two catering services for events across the Kansas City metro. Catering is separate
from everyday online ordering.

### The Pizza Trailer — on-site catering

$24 per guest, $1,500 event minimum. A staffed mobile pizzeria rolls
to your venue and bakes fresh hand-tossed 14-inch New York pies on site. The wedding and
event favorite.

### White Glove Delivery — drop-off catering

Flat $50 delivery fee plus the price of the pies. The Pizza Tascio
team (first-party, not a third-party app) delivers hot, ready-to-serve 18-inch pies in
insulated bags. Plan one pie per four guests.

Book at https://www.pizzatascio.com/tascio-to-go.

## Tascio Pizza Classes

Hands-on: stretch real dough, build & top your own 12" NY-style pie with a Tascio pizzaiolo, bake it in the deck oven — then eat it. Public classes or private events.

- Price: $90 per guest (public class); private events flat $1,400
for any group of 1–12 guests

- Capacity: up to 12 guests

- Where: the West 39th Street location, in a dedicated pizza-making
classroom

Book at https://www.pizzatascio.com/pizza-class.

## Pizza Tascio — Frequently Asked Questions

### Does Pizza Tascio sell pizza by the slice?

Yes. Fresh New York slices come out all day at every location. Slices are in-store only; online ordering covers whole pies and the rest of the menu for pickup or delivery.

### What makes it New York style pizza?

Hand-tossed dough cold-proofed three to four days, a thin crust that is crisp at the edge and foldable down the middle, and hot stone deck ovens — with Bianco DiNapoli sauce, whole-milk mozzarella, and Ezzo crispy cup pepperoni.

### What is The Combo?

Two big New York slices and a drink for $10, all day every day, in store at every location.

### How many locations does Pizza Tascio have?

Nine, across the Kansas City metro: North Kansas City, 39th Street, Waldo, Barry Road, and St. Joseph in Missouri, plus Overland Park, Olathe, Mission, and Belton in Kansas.

### Does Pizza Tascio deliver?

Whole pies and menu items can be ordered online for pickup or delivery. Slices are in-store only. For events, White Glove Delivery brings hot ready-to-serve pies for a flat $50 delivery fee plus the pies.

### How much does pizza catering cost in Kansas City?

The Pizza Trailer is $24 per guest with a $1,500 event minimum (on-site baking). White Glove Delivery is a flat $50 delivery fee plus the price of the pies.

### How big are the pies?

Whole pies are 18 inches and feed four to seven adults. The catering trailer bakes 14-inch pies on site; pizza classes build 12-inch pies.
